name: Casa Bianco
beschreibung:
Apart Casa Bianco in Soelden welcomes holidaymakers with a cosy alpine ambience and a prime location in the Oetztal. The contemporary apartments feature fully equipped kitchenettes, inviting living areas, and balconies overlooking imposing three-thousand-metre peaks.

Skiers and snowboarders can reach the Giggijoch and Gaislachkogl gondolas in just moments. In summer, the area turns into a haven for hikers, mountaineers, and mountain bikers.
kurzbeschreibung: Apart Casa Bianco in Soelden offers comfortable holiday apartments in the heart of the world-famous Oetztal valley.
